colophon.en: The prophecy of Samuel, the Lamanite, to the Nephites. Comprising chapters 13 through 15.
colophon.sm: O le valoaga a Samuelu, le sa Lamanā, ia sa Nifaē. E aofia ai mataupu 13 e oo atu i le 15.

heading.en: Samuel the Lamanite prophesies the destruction of the Nephites unless they repent—They and their riches are cursed—They reject and stone the prophets, are encircled about by demons, and seek for happiness in doing iniquity. About 6 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua valoia e Samuelu le sa Lamanā le faaumatiaga o sa Nifaē vagana ai ua latou salamo—Ua fetuuina i latou ma a latou oa—Ua latou teena perofeta ma fetogi i latou, ua siomia i latou e temoni, ma ua latou saili le fiafia i le fai o le amioletonu. E tusa o le 6 T.L.M.

w.en: And it came to pass that
and I will no longer suffer
And it shall come to pass,
and do all manner of iniquity
and seek all manner of ways
and say he is a prophet.
and ye shall not be able
in the days of your poverty.
And this shall be your language
